output_list.criticism: The 'transfer' function does not check for overflows, allowing attackers to exploit an integer overflow in the balanceOf mapping, granting themselves arbitrary tokens.
The 'transferFrom' function does not check for overflows, allowing attackers to exploit an integer overflow in the balanceOf mapping, granting themselves arbitrary tokens.
The 'mintToken' function allows the owner to create arbitrary tokens, granting them unlimited tokens.
The 'setPrices' function allows the owner to set the buy and sell prices, which can be manipulated to create a vulnerability.
The 'buy' function allows attackers to exploit an integer overflow in the balanceOf mapping, granting themselves arbitrary tokens.
